question: The MHC (major histocompatibility complex) class I molecules present peptides (from processed antigens), which are located in the cleft formed between:

options.opa: The alpha-1 and alpha-2 domains of the alpha chain.
options.opb: The alpha-2 and alpha-3 domains of the alpha chain.
options.opc: The alpha-1 domain and the beta-2microglobulin.
options.opd: The alpha-3 domain and the beta-2 microglobulin.
